decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south, east and west walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The detached single storey outbuilding must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as number 60 Cranford Lane and for no other purpose. A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover normal residential uses, such as separate self-contained accommodation nor the use of an outbuilding for primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen.

Condition : 3 - The side and rear walls of the building hereby approved shall be either rendered or tile hung in accordance with detailed drawings to a scale of not less than 1:50 and samples of the materials to be used that shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority within three months of the date of this permission and the building shall be finished in accordance with the details so approved within six months of the date of approval of those details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning. authority.
description: Retention of existing single storey outbuilding in rear garden.
